correctness.rationale: Every coefficient vector in [0,h] is realizable by placing its column's ones in h ordered slots. At h=p−1 the carry gap is a_j−(p−1)Σ_{i<j}a_i=1+Σ_{i=1}^jη_i, so the base-p order is strictly increasing and gives the whole support; uniqueness for individual subset-sum summands follows too. The proportion of indices of valuation j is (p−1)/p^{j+1} even for composite p; the omitted valuation tail has proportion at most p^{−J}. The floor-generated digits give bounded gaps iff they terminate, and m≤F(m)≤αm with error O_p(log(m+2)) proves the counting estimate by inversion. Independent choices within columns give the ordered binomial fiber, the exact finite moments by summation and Vandermonde, and the log-normalization CLT by the i.i.d. digits of a uniform index (variance zero precisely at p=2). Below criticality, unique digits and the two prefix cutoffs give the stated exponent. Positive α−1 makes some η_j positive, yielding a missing integer at h=p−1, and h+1 is missing if h<a_1−1. Conversely h≥max(p,a_1−1) makes a_1≤h+1 and a_j≤p a_{j−1}+p−1≤hΣ_{i<j}a_i+1 for j≥2, so successive shifted integer intervals cover every prefix range. These arguments cover exact, not merely eventual, coverage, including terminating parameters. The submitted rational finite checker was inspected, not run.

originality.rationale: The underlying denomination increment, base-two twofold coverage, and general completeness test are prior. The supported remainder is the quantitative classification of the actual critical repeated sumset, in particular the joint exact gap and ordered representation laws and the all-base distinction between positive-density onset and exact covering order. The closest earlier theorem is on a dilated sum, not the same object, and the inspected general criterion is not already a quantitative classification for this family.
residual_risks: The inaccessible exponential-denomination paper might give relevant special-case completeness implications; no full-text exclusion is claimed.

Unindexed general digital representation results might give additional coverage, and several individual consequences are elementary from the prior increment once the critical digit bijection is in place.

value.rationale: Repeated additive sums are a natural question for this already studied family. The exact h threshold separates sparsity, positive density and full coverage, and the critical support is described at the level of individual gaps and ordered representation multiplicities, not just existence or asymptotic order. These data give meaningful exact inputs for studying additive energies and finer representation behavior without attributing novelty or independent significance to Vandermonde or the standard CLT.
